branch_specs.band2_1x: score-free: join fund_7d NGUYEN VAN tu D1 artifact qua bar_index (kiem tra cheo signal_time trong clock D1); giu iff fund_7d >= 5e-05. Leverage 1.0.
branch_specs.control_1x: no-filter: pool NGUYEN VAN, leverage 1.0. PHAI tai hien so L1-pool 1x tu L1 summary (tol 1e-9 total_return/max_drawdown + exact trades/signals) neu khong thi STOP.
branch_specs.pctgate_1x: expanding-p90 top-decile validation-style (pattern v33-topdec/v42): sort theo signal_time; threshold_i = p90 cua strictly-past scores (min_history 10, warmup WAIT/drop); giu iff score_i >= threshold_i AND (fill >= 0.25 neu cot fill ton tai). Score = cot dau tien ton tai theo score_resolution_order. Neu khong co score column -> SKIP nhanh + ghi ly do (khong tu che scores). Leverage 1.0.
branch_specs.s0004_1x: score-free session: giu iff 0 <= UTC hour(signal_time) < 4 (function cua signal_time, inherently causal). Leverage 1.0.
branch_specs.t050_1x: fixed t050 (pattern v11): giu iff score >= 0.50 (cung resolved score nhu pctgate; score-only, khong fill gate them — ghi lai phan bo fill). Neu khong co score column -> SKIP nhanh + ghi ly do. Leverage 1.0.

causality: past-only closed-candle; percentile thresholds tu strictly-past scores; band2/s0004/t050 la functions cua frozen constants + signal_time/bar_index (causal); guard tu strictly-past exits; fill tu nen ke tiep.

dd_guard_conditional.execution: ExecutionConfig(leverage=0.25, max_leverage=1.0) + cot leverage 0.5/1.0 per-signal GIU LAI trong signals (keep-column quy uoc v49 de engine doc per-signal leverage; ghi nhan: v43 drop cot truoc backtest nen phang ve 0.25x, khong lap lai).
dd_guard_conditional.formula: Tai moi signal time cua nhanh duoc guard: past = exits cua control_1x CUA CHINH RUN NAY strictly before ts (1-microsecond cutoff, seed 100.0); lev = 0.5 neu level/peak < 0.9 else 1.0.
dd_guard_conditional.reference: control_1x equity CUA CHINH EXPERIMENT NAY (shared reference, quy uoc v11/v43 de so sanh).
dd_guard_conditional.run: CHI tren best-filter branch (non-control 1x co signals>0, normal monthly_geometric_net cao nhat) NEU re (signals>0 + tong backtest 1x < ~600s local). Else SKIP + ghi ly do. Khong phai branch pre-spec; ket qua luu rieng <best>_dd_guard/.
